result.title: Seeing Less in a Sparse World: Cross-View Geolocalization from Limited Field-of-View Observations
result.summary:
Cross-view geolocalization aims to determine the geographic location of a ground-level image by retrieving its corresponding satellite image, offering a promising alternative for localization in Global Navigation Satellite System (GNSS)-denied or degraded environments such as urban canyons, dense forests, and disaster scenarios. Despite recent progress, existing approaches remain limited by the lack of globally diverse training datasets and benchmarks that are often geographically restricted. Furthermore, most benchmarks rely on panoramic ground views, which do not reflect the limited field-of-view imagery captured by real world cameras.
  To address these challenges, we introduce Cross-View World 500k (CVW500k), a large-scale globally distributed dataset containing over 500,000 ground-satellite image pairs collected across diverse geographic regions and environments. Unlike previous datasets, CVW500k uses limited field-of-view ground images, providing a more realistic and challenging setting for cross-view geolocalization. In addition, we propose GeoQueryNet, a query-based cross-view fusion transformer framework designed to bridge the viewpoint gap between ground and satellite images. The model leverages a CLIP-based visual encoder with parameter-efficient LoRA adaptation and introduces a Cross-View Alignment Module that uses learnable query tokens to extract geographically consistent features across viewpoints. Our code can be found here: https://github.com/Fahim17/Cross_View_World_Dataset.git .

AI.brief_summary: 论文构建了包含 50 万以上地面—卫星图像对的全球分布式数据集 CVW500k，其地面图像采用受限视场，并提出 GeoQueryNet：基于 LoRA 适配 CLIP 编码器，用可学习 query token 的跨视角对齐模块融合地面与卫星特征以完成地理定位检索。
AI.relevance_reason: 其用可学习 query token 聚合受限视场观测、桥接视角差异的做法，或可供核查 LVR 中如何把不完整视觉证据压缩进 latent 状态；但论文本身面向检索定位任务，未涉及推理状态生成与使用。
